text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross steadily entered mock races,
continuing to hone her own brand of lightning.
(RUUUUMBLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, took up a nice spot in front.
Now I just gotta wait for the right moment...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! Right here!!
Doryaaaaaaaah!!

Her racing style was gradually coming together.
Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, what's up, squirt? Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Why're ya cryin'?! Calm down.
What in the world happened...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Mama's... not moving?
Isn't she just sleeping?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
How's Dad doing!?
If you can't reach him, call an ambulance!
Or go get a grown-up...!!

—All training was cancelled for the rest of the day.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm real sorry about that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
She said she managed to calm down.
Just that her stomach was doing somersaults for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said it should be fine, but...
I wonder if it really is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
There's no way... that could happen, right?
I... I...
choice_data_list: It's okay, if that's what the doctor says

text_block_list.text: Cheer her up. If her condition has entered a lull, there's likely nothing to worry about.

"If anything, Tamamo Cross was the one to worry about.
Her eyes were more timid and anxious than I'd ever seen before..."

To Tamamo Cross, her mother and family were
that much of a—
And two days later, at the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if Mom's doing okay...
Maybe she's asleep by now.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Whoops, can't just stand around!
Right now, I gotta focus!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh... I'm surrounded before I even noticed!?
Tch, how could I let my guard down...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's an opening right there!
Alright, let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Waaaagh, look out!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
(—Rat-a-tat-tat-boom, crash!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

The accident happened in a split second. The Umamusume running ahead of Tamamo Cross
collided and fell,
and she was caught up in the pileup.

Or perhaps Tamamo Cross could have dodged it
if her concentration was at its peak.
However—
(Wee-woo, wee-woo...)

—Dealing with the aftermath of the accident was tough.
Medical treatment and mental care. Luckily, no Umamusume
was severely injured, but...
Tamamo Cross took a hard hit to her body, too. Once permitted, I rushed over to check on her—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek, stay away! Don't come near me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer, huh...
Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The race... is over, huh...
Clashing and tangling at breakneck speed, I... we...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right now... don't come near me...
Sorry... please...

The diagnosis was "full-body contusions."
It took some time to fully recover.
However, what was even greater than that was—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(This is my chance! Go, go, go!
I have to go now!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: K-Krrrghhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I'm really sorry, Trainer.
I knew it in my heart.
I knew that 'this was my moment.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And yet... they won't move.
My legs just won't...!
So... I've got no choice but to go around...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, that won't make it in time.
It won't make it in time, but what happened back then... it's stuck in my head...
choice_data_list: You mean back during that accident...
You mean back during that accident, right...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. It's not like it happens often.
I know that... and yet... and yet...
Nggghhh...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong with these legs?!
Move! Move! Come on, MOOOVE!!"

The lingering fear from the collision
rusts her proud lightning.

An accident caused by her devotion to family. A split-second
hesitation turned into a crushing weight,
bearing down heavily on Tamamo Cross...

"—Because of this, Tamamo Cross looks like she'll have
a considerable chunk of her stamina drained every time she races for a while."
